title: Dex Share follower does not receive data (with older EU account)
body:
**Subject of the issue**
Dex Share follower (using xDrip+) doesn't receive any data (worked fine for many months until November 30th). 

**Your environment**
I don't believe this is related to my hardware/settings (Android 11). It worked fine until November 30th. No changes made to hardware and Android OS.
Software: xDrip+ using Dex Share follower
xDrip+ version is: 9ff5104-2021.11.23  (has been updated today because of the described problem; previous version showed the same problem)
xDrip+ is used by me (= follower of my daughter) using "Dex Share Follower" as data source
The data is uploaded by the Dexcom G6 App (used by my daughter).

**Expected behavior**
Dex Share follower (using xDrip+) should receive data from Dex share servers.

**Actual behavior**
No data is received by xDrip+. Error message in the log file:
"Get Share Data Failed: java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "Flat"
The Dexcom follow app functions normally.

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**
Set xDrip+ to Dex Share follower with matching credentials and server.

comments.body: Is the user name an email address?

This issue is not related to the user name. It looks like Dexcom changed the BG arrow trend indicator value (slope) from a number to a string because the following exception is raised:

```
Get Share Data Failed:
java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "Flat"
```
No. It is a "normal" name (only characters).
Okay, I see. So then other user are affected, too? What can be done to solve the problem?

I got the same issue. The issue occured Nov 30th in the evening.

I do suspect Dexcom having caused this by a change or incident within their environments.

At the same time xdrip lost the connection my original Dexcom app went down and was not usable anymore showing 'your device is not compatible' although it was officially declared as being compatible by dexcom. They seemed to have an serious incident which lasted at least one or two hours. Had to reinstall everything several times.

Dexcom service calling me today admitting they had an incident. 

Now the Dexcom app works again. The xdrip one does not.

Hope this information might help fencing it.
